verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents test-case scripting: its AI features generate test cases, the CLI runs API tests, and `hopp test` can emit JUnit reports for collection runs. That shows a test-assertion layer exists, but the evidence never describes the assertion API or which response fields it can check. missing for 10: documentation of assertions against response status, body, and headers specifically; a description of the test scripting API; independent or hands-on corroboration of writing tests.
